spec.title: Static Cloud Identity group has direct members
spec.description: Identifies static Cloud Identity groups with a complete empty direct membership list. Each group retains its own paginated read authority, so unrelated directory or transitive-list failures do not erase a confirmed empty group. Dynamic or external identity-mapped groups remain unresolved.
spec.remediation_hint: Confirm ownership and dependencies before removing an obsolete group or IAM grant.

evaluated: current complete Google directory group resource name and parent

description.fail_when: A static Google directory group has a complete empty direct membership list.

requirements.reason: Bounded group lifecycle evidence: a static Google directory group with a complete empty direct membership list has no assigned user. Nonempty membership can include nested groups and does not prove human-user assignment; organizational need and dynamic groups remain outside the predicate.

spec.predicate: The current matching grant has at least one permission recorded as exercised in this insight. The current matching grant has a fresh ACTIVE insight with at least 90 days of observation and no exercised or inferred permissions. Unavailable or foreign evidence remains unresolved.
spec.title: Current IAM role grant has observed permission use
spec.description: Reviews ACTIVE Google PERMISSIONS_USAGE insights against currently captured IAM grants. The resource, principal, role and condition expression must match. A fresh insight covering at least 90 days and listing neither exercised nor inferred permissions identifies a grant with no provider-observed permission use; it is not a claim that every role permission can safely be removed.
spec.remediation_hint: Confirm ownership and dependencies before removing an obsolete group or IAM grant.

description.pass_when: The current matching grant has at least one permission recorded as exercised in this insight.
description.fail_when: The current matching grant has a fresh ACTIVE insight with at least 90 days of observation and no exercised or inferred permissions.
description.not_applicable_when: A non-ACTIVE insight or another insight subtype is outside the permission-use predicate; missing or inconsistent evidence remains UNKNOWN or DENIED.

requirements.reason: Bounded access-review signal: the provider reports no permission use for an exact current role/member/condition grant during its observation interval. This supports review of obsolete access; organizational necessity and deactivation remain unverified.
